verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the merchant's data. The closest items are a one-line marketing tagline for 'Return Insights' ("actionable intelligence"), with no description of AI generation or how insights are surfaced. There are also model-driven fraud decisions retrieved via API and configurable Decision Center policies, but these are adjacent features, not AI insight or suggestion capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
